snippet.title: ITRP _ Vacuum Bless – New Graphics Trailer
snippet.description:
You are hanging on a spaceship amidst the endless vacuum.
You’ve got to options: either perish there, or collect yourself and find the fabled rescue shuttle.

It's my puzzle game. Wishlist now and sign up for playtest on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3341780/ITRP___Vacuum_Bless

I'm changed the visual style of the game. Now it has a retro. The previous one looked like this:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jmz1zFCTG80

#steam #gamedev #indiedev #indiegame #indiegamedev
